title: TF Regression Code Along - Exploratory Data Analysis - Continued

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, now let's go ahead and start our feature engineering process as well as getting rid of features that are not going to be useful to us.
cues.zh: 講師：好，現在開始特徵工程，也移除對我們沒有幫助的特徵。

cues.en: So we're gonna start working with this feature data and I always like to kind of review the data frame itself.
cues.zh: 開始處理這些特徵資料時，我總喜歡先檢視資料框本身。

cues.en: So something we can drop right away is this ID.
cues.zh: 可以立刻刪除的，是這個 ID。

cues.en: This ID is some sort of unique ID, there's no trend to it.
cues.zh: 它是某種唯一 ID，沒有明顯趨勢。

cues.en: And if there is, we probably don't really understand it based off this number itself.
cues.zh: 就算有，光憑這個數字，我們也大概無法理解。

cues.en: So I will just say df is equal to df dot drop and then go ahead and drop that ID column.
cues.zh: 所以使用 df = df.drop，刪除 ID 欄。

cues.en: And epsilon axis is equal to one.
cues.zh: 並設定 axis=1。

cues.en: So we go ahead and just drop that ID column.
cues.zh: 這樣就把 ID 欄刪掉了。

cues.en: And the next thing we're gonna do is check out the date column.
cues.zh: 接著查看 date 欄。

cues.en: So if we take a look at this date column right now it looks to be just some sort of string.
cues.zh: 現在看起來，date 只是某種字串。

cues.en: So we can convert it to a datetime object by doing the following.
cues.zh: 可以用以下方式轉成 datetime 物件。

cues.en: I can say df date is equal to pd to underscore datetime and pass in df date.
cues.zh: 設定 df 的 date 欄等於 pd.to_datetime，傳入 df 的 date 欄。

cues.en: And what this does is it's going to automatically convert this string to be a datetime object.
cues.zh: 這會自動把字串轉成 datetime 物件。

cues.en: And once it's a datetime object that means I can extract information, such as the month or year automatically.
cues.zh: 成為 datetime 物件後，就能自動擷取月份、年份等資訊。

cues.en: So I go ahead and run this.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And now if I take a look at my date column, note the formatting is different and it now reports back that it's a datetime object, which means I can begin to perform feature engineering
cues.zh: 再查看 date 欄，注意格式不同了，而且顯示為 datetime 物件，代表我能開始據此進行，

cues.en: off of this.
cues.zh: 特徵工程。

cues.en: This datetime by itself may not be useful, but I can extract the year component and the month component.
cues.zh: datetime 本身可能沒有幫助，但可以擷取年份和月份。

cues.en: And the way I can do that is through a couple of simple calls.
cues.zh: 做法是幾個簡單的呼叫。

cues.en: I can say df year is equal to df date and I can apply a function that actually extracts the year
cues.zh: 讓 df 的 year 欄等於 df 的 date 欄，再套用函數，擷取年份，

cues.en: from this datetime.
cues.zh: 從這個 datetime 取得年份。

cues.en: So if I have a datetime object it's simply an attribute call to grab the year itself.
cues.zh: 如果有 datetime 物件，只需要讀取屬性，就能取得年份。

cues.en: And I can do this with a simple lambda expression by saying lambda date and then say date month.
cues.zh: 可以用簡單的 lambda 運算式，寫 lambda date，再存取 date.month。

cues.en: If you're unfamiliar with lambda expressions, that's essentially shorthand for a function.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉 lambda，它基本上就是函數的簡寫。

cues.en: So to show you what I mean by that this lambda expression would be the exact same thing as if I did this.
cues.zh: 我示範一下，這個 lambda 運算式和以下做法完全相同。

cues.en: We'll create a function called year extraction, takes in some date, and then it returns back date dot year or date dot month.
cues.zh: 建立 year_extraction 函數，傳入日期，再傳回 date.year 或 date.month。

cues.en: And in this case, this should actually be year in order to match up with what I'm calling the column here.
cues.zh: 這裡其實應該是 year，才能符合這個欄位的名稱。

cues.en: So this lambda expression is the exact same thing as running this right here.
cues.zh: 所以這個 lambda 運算式和執行這個函數完全一樣。

cues.en: So recall that when built in Python, you have this datetime object and you can grab the attributes of year, month, et cetera, which is why we called pd to datetime
cues.zh: 請記得，Python 內建 datetime 物件，可以取得 year、month 等屬性，因此才先對原始字串欄，

cues.en: on the original string column.
cues.zh: 呼叫 pd.to_datetime。

cues.en: And then this lambda expression is essentially shorthand for that.
cues.zh: 而 lambda 運算式基本上就是簡寫。

cues.en: And I'm going to copy and paste this for month as well.
cues.zh: 我也把它複製貼上，用來擷取 month。

cues.en: And this is essentially feature engineering because these features were technically hidden inside of the string date and now I'm creating new columns to
cues.zh: 這就是特徵工程，因為這些特徵原本藏在日期字串裡，而我現在建立新欄，

cues.en: try to extract or engineer more information off my original features.
cues.zh: 試著從原始特徵擷取或建構更多資訊。

cues.en: This is a very common step, especially with timestamps.
cues.zh: 這是很常見的步驟，尤其在處理時間戳記時。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and run this.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And now if I take a look at the head of my data frame I have this newly formatted datetime column.
cues.zh: 現在查看資料框前幾列，可以看到格式轉換後的 datetime 欄。

cues.en: And I'll scroll all the way to the right here, and I should see my new year and month column.
cues.zh: 捲到最右邊，應該會看到新的 year 和 month 欄。

cues.en: And now I can do some sort of exploratory data analysis to see if these are useful features in general.
cues.zh: 現在可以做些探索式資料分析，看看這些特徵是否有用。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and see if there's any variation based off the month that this is selling at.
cues.zh: 先看看房屋售出的月份是否造成差異。

cues.en: So maybe we price things higher if we believe they're going to go on market in December versus in March.
cues.zh: 例如，預計十二月上市的房子，是否應該比三月上市的房子定價高。

cues.en: So I can do that by saying sns box plot and let's go ahead and see the distribution per month.
cues.zh: 可以用 sns.boxplot，查看每個月的價格分布。

cues.en: And another way I could do this is through grouping by month and then doing a describe on the price column as well, which is essentially what a box plot does visually.
cues.zh: 另一種方式是依月份分組，對 price 欄呼叫 describe，箱形圖基本上就是把這些資訊視覺化。

cues.en: Now let's make this just a little larger.
cues.zh: 現在把圖稍微放大。

cues.en: We'll say plt figure fig size, make this something like 10 by 6, go ahead and run this.
cues.zh: 使用 plt.figure，figsize 設成 10 乘 6，然後執行。

cues.en: And I can see the distributions here.
cues.zh: 這裡就能看到分布。

cues.en: Now it's hard to tell just from this plot whether or not there is any significant distribution differences between the month that you're gonna sell this house at.
cues.zh: 但光看這張圖，不容易判斷不同售屋月份的分布是否有明顯差異。

cues.en: And what might be easier to do is just see the numbers themselves.
cues.zh: 直接看數字可能比較容易。

cues.en: So I could do df group by call month here and then just see what's the average price per month.
cues.zh: 可以對 df 呼叫 groupby，傳入 month，查看每月平均價格。

cues.en: So I'll take the mean after I do the group by and then just explore the price.
cues.zh: groupby 後取 mean，再選取 price。

cues.en: And then here, this maybe will allow me to actually see or read the numbers myself to see if there's some sort of significant difference between the months.
cues.zh: 這樣也許就能直接閱讀數字，判斷月份之間是否有明顯差異。

cues.en: And if I wanna see this visually, I could also just call dot plot and this would show me the behavior.
cues.zh: 如果想用圖觀察，也可以直接呼叫 .plot，顯示變化情形。

cues.en: So it looks like maybe there's some sort of difference between the months if we actually see the total Y range.
cues.zh: 如果查看完整的 Y 軸範圍，似乎月份之間有一些差異。

cues.en: It only goes from 5 million ish to around five and a half million ish, so not a huge difference here in the price, excuse me, actually 510,000 versus 560,000.
cues.zh: 大約從 500 萬到 550 萬，價格差異不大；抱歉，實際上是 51 萬到 56 萬。

cues.en: So not a huge range, but it looks like there's some behavior differences there in the months themselves.
cues.zh: 所以範圍不算大，但月份之間似乎有些行為差異。

cues.en: And we could do similar things for the year.
cues.zh: 年份也可以做類似分析。

cues.en: So if I wanted to explore the year, this plot definitely makes sense because if you look back at King County sales, they're just increasing in price as time goes on.
cues.zh: 如果探索年份，這張圖滿合理的，因為回看金郡房屋交易，價格隨時間上漲。

cues.en: And you would expect that just naturally with inflation unless there's some sort of a major housing event.
cues.zh: 除非發生重大房市事件，否則光是通貨膨脹，通常也會有這種預期。

cues.en: Okay, so we featured engineered year and month.
cues.zh: 好，我們已經透過特徵工程建立 year 和 month。

cues.en: We'll go ahead and just keep them in there, see if the model uses them or not.
cues.zh: 先保留它們，看看模型會不會使用。

cues.en: And we'll drop out our date column.
cues.zh: 然後刪除 date 欄。

cues.en: We'll say df is equal to df dot drop
cues.zh: 使用 df = df.drop，

cues.en: and we will drop off that original date column since it's no longer useful to us since we feature engineered what we.
cues.zh: 刪掉原始 date 欄，因為所需資訊已經透過特徵工程取出，它不再有用。

cues.en: Now let's take a quick look again at what remaining columns we have.
cues.zh: 現在再快速看看還剩哪些欄。

cues.en: We can either do this with df columns or I can simply just check the head of my data frame to begin exploring this.
cues.zh: 可以使用 df.columns，或直接查看資料框前幾列，開始探索。

cues.en: A lot of these features actually make sense already the way they are.
cues.zh: 許多特徵目前的形式已經很合理。

cues.en: So number of bedrooms, bathrooms, square foot living.
cues.zh: 例如臥室數、浴室數和居住面積。

cues.en: Doesn't look like we have to do a lot of feature engineering here.
cues.zh: 看起來不必做太多特徵工程。

cues.en: And even the waterfront and view type categories those are already in dummy variable form for us.
cues.zh: 連 waterfront 和 view 這類特徵，都已經是虛擬變數形式。

cues.en: So it's either a zero or one.
cues.zh: 也就是零或一。

cues.en: Something that we wanna maybe take note of is this zip code column.
cues.zh: 我們可能需要留意的是 zipcode 欄。

cues.en: So notice the zip code is numerical and if we feed this directly into our model, the model will assume that it's some sort of continuous feature that somehow zip code
cues.zh: 注意，郵遞區號是數字；如果直接輸入模型，模型會把它視為某種連續特徵，認為郵遞區號，

cues.en: 98178 is greater than 98125.
And this may or may not be the case depending on how the zip codes are actually mapped out on a real map.
cues.zh: 這是否合理，取決於郵遞區號在真實地圖上的分布。

cues.en: So this is where domain experience comes into play.
cues.zh: 這時就需要領域經驗。

cues.en: You'd have to either look up the maps yourself, so you can do a quick Google search and find some sort of zip code mapping on top of King County and see if there actually is a relationship.
cues.zh: 你需要自己查地圖，例如快速用 Google 搜尋金郡的郵遞區號地圖，看看是否真的有關係。

cues.en: You could zoom in here and see if there's a relationship between the numbers zip codes are assigned versus maybe their latitude or longitude.
cues.zh: 可以放大，觀察郵遞區號的數字，和經度或緯度是否有關。

cues.en: And you can also do that through some sort of correlation plot.
cues.zh: 也可以透過某種相關性圖查看。

cues.en: But if you take a closer look at this there doesn't seem to be a clear continuous distribution of these actual zip codes, which means you would wanna start treating this
cues.zh: 但仔細看，這些郵遞區號似乎沒有明確的連續分布，表示應該開始把它，

cues.en: as a categorical variable.
cues.zh: 當成類別變數。

cues.en: So again, we'll come back to our notebook here and begin exploring this and see if it's actually viable to keep it as some sort of category.
cues.zh: 再回到筆記本探索，看看把它保留為某種類別特徵是否可行。

cues.en: So we can say something like df zip code and call value counts on it.
cues.zh: 可以對 df 的 zipcode 欄呼叫 value_counts。

cues.en: And this will give us an idea of how many actual unique zip codes we have and what their distribution is like across the dataset.
cues.zh: 這能讓我們了解有多少種不同的郵遞區號，以及它們在資料集中的分布。

cues.en: And it looks like we have 70 unique zip codes.
cues.zh: 看起來有 70 個不同的郵遞區號。

cues.en: So this is probably too much to just call pd, get dummies on this, and then have 70 categories of zip codes.
cues.zh: 所以直接呼叫 pd.get_dummies，建立 70 個郵遞區號類別，可能太多了。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and for this particular case we will drop the zip code column because 70 categories is just too much for us.
cues.zh: 因此這個案例中，我們會刪除 zipcode 欄，因為 70 個類別對這裡而言太多。

cues.en: However, what we could do is with a little bit of domain experience and domain knowledge, maybe try to categorize this based off what we know are expensive zip codes versus maybe less expensive zip codes.
cues.zh: 不過，若具備一些領域經驗和知識，也許可以依據哪些郵遞區號昂貴、哪些便宜，把它們分類。

cues.en: Or we could do some sort of mapping or grouping to do zip codes in the south, zip codes in the middle, and zip codes in the north, east and west, et cetera.
cues.zh: 也可以映射或分組，分成南部、中部、北部、東部和西部等郵遞區號。

cues.en: But this will take then a lot more manual work here and it also takes a lot more experience of what King County is actually like.
cues.zh: 但這需要更多人工處理，也需要更熟悉金郡的實際情況。

cues.en: So again, a big part of machine learning and data science is to contact someone with domain experience and try to get those mappings and feature engineerings in place.
cues.zh: 所以機器學習和資料科學很重要的一環，就是聯絡具有領域經驗的人，建立這些映射和特徵工程。

cues.en: But for our use case, there's 70 categories here.
cues.zh: 不過，就我們的案例來說，這裡有 70 個類別。

cues.en: We'll go ahead and just ignore them for now.
cues.zh: 目前先忽略它們。

cues.en: However, in a more realistic situation you would probably want to take the time to look at a map and start mapping these out yourself manually.
cues.zh: 在更真實的情境中，你可能會想花時間查地圖，自己手動建立映射。

cues.en: So we'll say df is equal to df drop and kind of for the sake of time really we'll drop the zip code column.
cues.zh: 所以使用 df = df.drop，主要是為了節省時間，刪掉 zipcode 欄。

cues.en: And then there's other things we can take a look at.
cues.zh: 還有其他可以查看的內容。

cues.en: Another one that may be kind of troublesome is this year renovated.
cues.zh: 另一個可能有點麻煩的是 year renovated，也就是整修年份。

cues.en: You'll notice that year renovated, if we take a look at it, df year renovated, let's do a value count on that.
cues.zh: 查看 yr_renovated，對它呼叫 value_counts。

cues.en: Most of the values are actually zero, which essentially implies that it was not renovated.
cues.zh: 多數值其實是零，基本上表示沒有整修過。

cues.en: So you're stuck in a zero there.
cues.zh: 所以填了一個零。

cues.en: And then we have 2014, 2013, et cetera.
cues.zh: 其他則是 2014、2013 等年份。

cues.en: Now there's different approaches we can take here as far as feature engineering is concerned.
cues.zh: 在特徵工程上，有幾種不同的處理方式。

cues.en: One main issue here that we can tell is that zero is not actually a year.
cues.zh: 可以看出的一個主要問題，是零其實不是年份。

cues.en: Instead it's basically an indication that the house was not renovated.
cues.zh: 它表示房子沒有整修過。

cues.en: So it may make more sense to categorize this as renovated or not renovated, essentially turn all these years, using a custom dot apply function,
cues.zh: 所以分類成整修過或未整修，可能更合理；用自訂的 .apply 函數，把所有年份，

cues.en: into a kind of positive renovated call, and then keep zero as just not renovated.
cues.zh: 轉成表示整修過的正值，零則保留為未整修。

cues.en: So we could do that through an apply function.
cues.zh: 可以透過 apply 函數做到。

cues.en: However, we can actually take advantage of the situation by thinking of it in the following fashion.
cues.zh: 不過，我們也能這樣思考，利用目前的情況。

cues.en: Notice that it's most likely the more recent the year of renovation, essentially the higher the value of this year renovated, then the more likely
cues.zh: 注意，整修年份越近，也就是整修年份的數值越高，通常越可能，

cues.en: that the house is going to have a higher sale price.
cues.zh: 讓房屋售價更高。

cues.en: And we can just think of that intuitively because the more recent the renovation the better.
cues.zh: 直覺上，整修時間越近越好。

cues.en: And since zero actually follows along with this correlation, it's almost like the lowest year possible, then we should expect that to also have little value.
cues.zh: 而零也符合這個相關方向，就像最低的年份，因此預期價值也比較低。

cues.en: So in this case, we're actually kind of lucky and due to the scaling from zero to the highest year, higher should correlate with more value and we can actually just keep this as is.
cues.zh: 所以這裡其實有點幸運，從零到最高年份的尺度中，數值越高應該越有價值，可以直接保留。

cues.en: And that's essentially the kind of lucky situation we find ourselves in, that the years happen to go in a positive direction
cues.zh: 這算是我們碰巧遇到的有利情況，年份剛好沿著正向排列，

cues.en: and the higher years tend to correlate with more value.
cues.zh: 較高的年份通常和較高價值相關。

cues.en: Because the more recent a renovation, just intuitively you expect that to have more value.
cues.zh: 因為直覺上，整修時間越近，就越有價值。

cues.en: Now that won't always be the case for things that are years and then have zeros filled in, but in our case we got kinda lucky here and that makes sense to just leave it in.
cues.zh: 有年份又用零填入的資料，不一定都適用這種做法，但這裡剛好合理，可以保留。

cues.en: However, you could perform more feature engineering off of this by categorizing it into renovated versus not renovated.
cues.zh: 不過你也可以進一步做特徵工程，分成整修過和未整修兩類。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then other things we can do, is we can take a look here at something like the square feet in the basement, kind of a similar situation.
cues.zh: 其他像地下室的平方英尺面積，也有類似情況。

cues.en: So if I take square feet in basement and do value counts on it,
cues.zh: 取得地下室面積欄，呼叫 value_counts，

cues.en: you'll notice that in a similar situation it just has zero there for a lot of the entries.
cues.zh: 會看到許多資料同樣填了零。

cues.en: And zero most likely just means there is no basement there.
cues.zh: 零很可能表示沒有地下室。

cues.en: So they just put in a zero for square feet in basement.
cues.zh: 所以地下室面積就填零。

cues.en: Now we can see here again the values starting to go upwards et cetera.
cues.zh: 這裡也可以看到數值逐漸增加。

cues.en: And these also basically make sense as a continuous variable because we would expect that if there is no basement, it would have less value than having an extremely large basement.
cues.zh: 當成連續變數基本上也合理，因為我們預期沒有地下室的房屋，價值會比有超大地下室的低。

cues.en: So we can also keep this as is.
cues.zh: 因此這欄也可以保留原樣。

cues.en: So a lot of times you'll have to make the decision in feature engineering if you wanna make a continuous variable categorical, or just keep it as continuous.
cues.zh: 很多時候，特徵工程需要決定是否將連續變數轉成類別變數，或繼續保留為連續變數。

cues.en: And you have to really think carefully if it's valid to keep it as continuous.
cues.zh: 必須仔細思考，保留為連續變數是否合理。

cues.en: And for these two it's not a crazy assumption to keep them as continuous and leave these zeros as kind of your bottom marker.
cues.zh: 對這兩欄而言，保留連續形式，讓零作為最低點，並不是離譜的假設。

cues.en: Alright, so that's it for our feature analysis and feature engineering section.
cues.zh: 好，特徵分析和特徵工程部分就到這裡。

cues.en: Later on in your section exercise you'll be doing a lot more feature engineering than what we've done here.
